native_accuracy.definition: Accuracy selecting argmax among the sixteen answer tokens.

grouped_canonical_accuracy.definition: Accuracy selecting argmax among the sixteen answer tokens.

guard_block0_accuracy.definition: Accuracy selecting argmax among the sixteen answer tokens.

guard_minus_mean_shams_conditional_targe.definition: Mean over cases of p16(target) under guard_block0 minus the equally weighted mean under sham_0 through sham_7; p16 conditions on all sixteen permitted answer tokens, not only the four displayed values.

guard_block5_accuracy.definition: Accuracy selecting argmax among the sixteen answer tokens.

guard_all_accuracy.definition: Accuracy selecting argmax among the sixteen answer tokens.

interval_interpretation: Broad subjective plausibility intervals, not calibrated, with no asserted nominal coverage. Not sampling confidence intervals or exclusion rules.
forecast_scoring: Report all six point errors and misses at tolerance .10, plus mean absolute error. Descriptive only; separate protocol defines causal pass decisions.
substantive_hypothesis: The unchanged block-0 guard is unlikely to restore near-native final answers in this twelve-block pretrained model, although a modest benefit is plausible. Block-5 and all-block masks are secondary and cannot rescue the block-0 claim.

allowed_evidence: Selected format name and sample size supplied without scores
blinding.isolation: Procedural role separation on a shared filesystem; not OS-enforced.

scope.conditional_probability_denominator: Sum of ordinary next-token probabilities of the sixteen permitted single-token answers 20 through 35.
scope.sham_weighting: Equal weight for all eight shams within the same case, then equal case mean.
